officialText:
Section 725.48(B)(1) – Revise Section 725.48(B)(1) to read as follows:

(1)In a Cable, Enclosure, or Raceway. Class 1 circuits and power-supply circuits shall be permitted to occupy the same cable, enclosure, or raceway without a barrier only where the equipment powered is functionally associated. Class I circuits shall be permitted to be installed together with the conductors of electric light, power, and medium power network-powered broadband communications circuits where separated by a barrier.
